newsitem.title: USA: Dade Cty, Fla., officials subpoenaed in muni probe.
newsitem.headline: Dade Cty, Fla., officials subpoenaed in muni probe.

text.p: Dade County Finance Director Ed Marquez said on Friday that he had been subpoenaed to testify before a federal grand jury investigating corruption in the county's bond deals.
Marquez said County Manager Armando Vidal and bond administrator Lidia Monzon had also been subpoenaed to appear before the grand jury in Miami on Tuesday.
The grand jury subpoenas came one day after federal prosecutors subpoeaned records from numerous Dade County bond deals involving the California firm Grigsby Brandford & Co.
The first subpoena also requested records related to the method the county uses to select bond underwriters and records for several past and upcoming bond deals involving Grigsby Brandford.
"The inkling I got is they're going to cover the same stuff they're asking for on the other subpoenas," Marquez said of his pending grand jury appearance.
Marquez said federal investigators gave no indication how long the grand jury investigation would last.
Vidal and Monzon were not immediately available for comment late on Friday.

The Miami Herald reported on Thursday that FBI videotapes show Calvin Grigsby, the former president of the Grigsby Brandford & Co, a San Francisco-based municipal bond firm, allegedly offering Dade County Commissioner James Burke a $300,000 kickback in exchange for steering a $183 million Dade County bond deal to the firm.
The conversation allegedly took place last month in a San Francisco hotel where Burke, Grigsby and Miami municipal bond firm owner Howard Gary discussed the kickbacks, the newspaper said.

The first set of subpoenaes sought records relating to that deal, which refunded a revenue bond issue for a recyling plant. Also subpoenaed were records documenting how Grigsby Brandford was chosen as senior manager for the issue.
Burke has denied wrongdoing and told Reuters there was no bribe. Gary, Grigsby, the FBI and federal prosecutors have all declined to comment.
